overall: Both English essays preserve the full argument, examples, competing positions and conclusions. English already usefully qualifies several Chinese overstatements: old implement withdrawn from authorized competition rather than physically nonexistent; old sequence closed rather than distance impossible; no uniquely compelled objective choice rather than no reasons. Keep those improvements. Resolve factual source errors and remove source-reporting markers/translator notes from publication prose only after their concerns are addressed.

findings.severity: required consistency with already acceptedEP05 boundary
findings.before_zh: 比蒙那一跳的条件里没有一个可以立法处理的东西，风是合规的，海拔是地理。
findings.after_zh: 比蒙那一跳的风在当时规则内，海拔也没有被设为排除纪录的条件。机构不能改变当地海拔，却可以决定怎样分类、标注或认定高海拔成绩。
findings.before_en: Beamon's circumstances offered nothing that could be addressed through legislation: the wind was legal, and the altitude was geography.
findings.after_en: Beamon's wind was within the rules, and altitude was not an exclusion from record eligibility. A federation could not alter the site's altitude, but could decide how high-altitude performances were classified, identified or recognized.
findings.followup: In paragraph12 change 没有任何可以立法的抓手/无能为力/只能原样收下 to 当时并未另分海拔纪录序列/选择在既有序列承认; change English no legislative lever/powerless/could only accept likewise. Retain exact physical-condition versus editable-implement contrast and23-year record duration.
findings.reason: Cannot physically change altitude does not mean cannot regulate record eligibility. This is conceptual consistency, not a new claim that the body had to cancel Beamon.

findings.kind: source nonmonotonic trend and universal prediction claim
findings.before_zh: 趋势是可以外推的，因为它是连续的，一年比一年远，画一条线就能看出它往哪里去。
findings.after_zh: 这里可以外推的是距离上限可能扩张的趋势，不是每个赛季都比上一年更远，也不是一条画出来就必然兑现的直线。
findings.before_en: A trend can be extrapolated because it has continuity: draw its direction and one can see where it is heading.
findings.after_en: Here the extrapolation concerned a potentially expanding upper range, not a guarantee that each season would exceed the last or that a drawn line must come true.
findings.additional_scope: Paragraph9 构对趋势可以提前，对单个的意外只能滞后 and paragraph10 意外没有先兆/只能事后清理 should be narrowed to the two cases' different planning situations: developing range/landing problems supported advance testing; this particular somersault forced a response after its demonstration. Keep tide/meteor metaphor as an illustration, not a general law that all novel techniques are unforeseeable.
findings.reason: Paragraph2.5–7 explicitly rejects monotonic seasonal progress. EN already removed source's year-on-year phrase, but retains an unnecessarily universal deterministic forecast versus surprise dichotomy.

findings.before_zh: 新的重量分布把压力中心移到了重心的后面
findings.after_zh: 新规格使重心相对于气动力的作用位置前移，并配合外形限制，改变了飞行中的俯仰特性
findings.before_en: The new mass distribution placed the centre of pressure behind the centre of gravity
findings.after_en: The new specification moved the centre of gravity forward relative to the aerodynamic forces and, together with shape restrictions, changed the pitching behaviour
findings.reason: Moving mass shifts centre of gravity, not by itself the aerodynamic centre of pressure. Retain qualified positive-angle nose-down tendency; don't suggest all wind/angle/flight conditions are identical. In paragraph7 replace 两问题同时解决/one shift dealt with both by 同时改善落地判定与控制射程/helped both landing adjudication and range control. This matches the described tests without declaring flat landings mathematically impossible.

findings.kind: source contradicts cited primary testimony about purpose
findings.before_zh: 后来关于这次改动到底主要是为了哪一个的争论，才一直没有定论。
findings.after_zh: 布雷米克的技术委员会回顾明确把清楚、可测量的落地列为主要目标，同时说明射程和未来改动成本为什么推动了四厘米方案。我们没有因此拿到每一场讨论的完整记录，但也不能说主次完全没有证词。
findings.before_en: Yet precisely because it served both purposes, disagreement over which was primary has persisted.
findings.after_en: Bremicker's committee account explicitly identifies clear, measurable landings as the primary goal, while explaining why range and future redesign costs favoured four centimetres. This is not a complete record of every discussion, but it is direct testimony about the priorities.
findings.reason: Primary account explicitly separates primary adjudication goal from range/cost reasons for4cm. Adjust whole paragraph's luck/merely-incidental range language accordingly: both were considered, not a fortunate wholly unplanned side-effect. The two kinds of problem distinction is worth retaining.

findings.kind: source unavailable archive versus nonexistent process record
findings.before_zh: 没有留下它的过程，那次决定关账的讨论。
findings.after_zh: 而在本次能取得的材料中，决定如何形成的完整讨论不易复原。
findings.before_en: but not the process, the discussion that decided to close the book
findings.after_en: while the available material does not let us reconstruct the complete discussion that led to it
findings.followup: Paragraph5 1928逐条辩论没有被记下→未找到可取得的逐条辩论记录. Paragraph6 没有人能看到→本文尚未取得完整原始决策记录. Paragraph7 几乎从不保存/每个结论任何一次推理/工厂不会保管每操作 should become this essay's finding that published outcomes are easier to obtain than complete deliberative trails, without asserting preservation practices/motives for every decision or factory.
findings.reason: The essay6.2 properly acknowledges source-access limitation. It does not prove no minutes were made, no process preserved, or all factories discard manufacturing logs. Keep metaphor lightly, don't convert search limitations into institutional-history certainty. EN already softens final any/every wording but retains a blanket not-preserved premise.

findings.kind: source physical versus institutional impossibility; general equation versus distance-only scalar

patches.before_zh: 霍恩那一投，是用一件已经不存在的器械投出的。
patches.after_zh: 霍恩那一投用的是已经退出现行项目许可范围的旧规格器械。

patches.after_en: NO-OP: English already correctly qualifies authorization, not physical existence.

patches.before_zh: 一百零四米八零不能被追平，因为投出它的那支标枪已经不存在了。

patches.before_zh: 因为那个值，不存在。它不是还没算出来，是它作为一个数就不成立。

patches.before_en: That uniquely equivalent value does not exist. It is not simply a number nobody has yet worked out; as a single determinate number, it is not well-defined.
patches.after_en: The old distance alone does not define one uniquely equivalent value. Conditional modelling remains possible, but it cannot recover an unstated, uniquely determined counterfactual from that number alone.

findings.echoes: Apply same bounded reading to7.10 and8.2/12/15/16 where Chinese says 永远不可比/无法被追平/方程不成立. Most English echoes already say within progression/universal/uniquely equivalent and should not be expanded unnecessarily.

findings.kind: source physiological endpoint versus race-time outcome
findings.before_zh: 个体的响应从百分之十一点三的劣势，到百分之十一点四的收益。
findings.after_zh: 在这七名肯尼亚选手与所测鞋款的组合中，实验室跑步经济性的响应从百分之十一点三的劣势，到百分之十一点四的收益。
findings.before_en: responses to the tested advanced shoes ranged from an 11.3-percent disadvantage to an 11.4-percent benefit
findings.after_en: laboratory running-economy responses across the seven Kenyan runners and tested shoe models ranged from an11.3-percent detriment to an11.4-percent benefit
findings.ending_change: 有少数人穿某个型号反而更慢 / a few become slower in a particular model → 有人穿某个型号在给定速度下反而耗能更多 / some used more energy at the fixed test speed in a particular model.
findings.reason: Keep real individual-response evidence, sample and full range. It measures submaximal physiological economy, not a measured11% race-time swing or universal response distribution. Section2.5 already carefully distinguishes economy from race time; paragraph6 must not undo that. Section6.5 English already says laboratory benefits, retain.

findings.before_zh: 这两个解释都不能被证明，因为你没有办法做一个随机对照实验，让一半的顶尖选手穿新鞋，一半穿旧鞋跑十年。所以那个加速有多少来自鞋，永远算不清。
findings.after_zh: 没有那种把顶尖选手长期随机分配到新旧鞋的试验，观察性资料中的混杂就需要认真处理。现有证据支持鞋有作用，却不能把这段整体加速精确、唯一地拆成鞋与其他因素各占多少；这不等于所有因果研究都无效，或未来证据也不可能改进估计。
findings.before_en: Neither explanation can be conclusively proved, because no randomized trial can assign half the world's best runners new shoes and the other half old ones for ten years.
findings.after_en: Without long-term randomized assignment, confounding in observational data needs careful treatment. The evidence supports a footwear contribution without uniquely and exactly apportioning the entire acceleration between shoes and other influences. This does not invalidate all causal research or rule out better estimates.
findings.reason: Absence/impracticality of one ideal experiment is not proof no causal attribution is possible forever. EN already avoids source's forever but the deterministic proof premise still should be narrowed. Retain connection to Beamon's interacting causes.

findings.kind: source internal review versus independent evidence; derivation versus justification

patches.before_zh: 世界田径引用了一个独立专家审查
patches.after_zh: 世界田径援引了内部援助审查组对独立研究的审阅
patches.before_en: World Athletics cited an independent expert review
patches.after_en: World Athletics cited its internal Assistance Review Group's assessment of independent research

patches.before_zh: 而它为什么划在这里而不是那里，没有写下来。精确和有据，又一次是两回事。
patches.after_zh: 那份公告没有给出把边界唯一推到四十毫米的定量过程；但它公开说明了保护竞赛完整性、暂缓更激进设计以及继续研究的考虑。没有唯一的实验推导，不等于没有理由。
patches.before_en: without recording why it belongs here rather than elsewhere. Precision and justification are once again different things.
patches.after_en: without publishing a quantitative derivation uniquely fixing forty millimetres. It did publish policy reasons: protecting competition integrity, pausing more radical designs and allowing further research. Lacking a unique experimental derivation is not the same as lacking justification.
patches.scope: Also narrow final no traceable reason to no published calculation uniquely fixes40 in that announcement; whole paragraph should not retain an opposite closing assertion.

patches.before_zh: 构只能靠决断给出，给不出推导。
patches.after_zh: 数据可以帮助评估不同边界的后果，规则也可以公开说明取舍；但仅靠实验，不能从连续的效果里推出唯一应当采用的界线。
patches.before_en: The construct can supply a decision, not a derivation.
patches.after_en: Data can inform the consequences of different limits, and a rule can explain its trade-offs. An experiment alone cannot turn a continuous effect into the one boundary that ought to be adopted.
patches.reason: Normative choice remains, without declaring all regulatory derivation impossible or a continuous variable proof of arbitrariness.

patches.before_zh: 结论留下了，过程散失了。
patches.after_zh: 公告留下了结论与部分理由，完整的提案和审议过程在这里取得的材料中还不能复原。
patches.before_en: the conclusion remains, while the process is missing
patches.after_en: the conclusion and some reasons are public, while the available material does not reconstruct the full proposal and deliberation process

findings.preserve: Paragraph12's carefully scoped lack of every-stage complete membership is not disproved by the2020 initial review-group roster. Retain that scope, and avoid suggesting no group membership was ever published. Paragraph7/title can still say no complete public quantitative derivation located, not no grounds exist.

findings.kind: source conflates favourable conditions with prohibited assistance
findings.before_zh: 轮换的空气动力学配速员，理想的配速，移动的补给，赛道的选择，天气的控制，这些里面任何一样，单独就足以让这次尝试没有纪录资格。
findings.after_zh: 轮换进入的非参赛配速员与移动补给等安排，涉及正常比赛的辅助和补给限制，足以使这次定制尝试不能按普通纪录条件认定。理想配速、选择合适赛道与好天气，则不能仅因有利就各自算成违规；要核对具体的比赛、赛道和辅助条件。
findings.before_en: The source lists rotating aerodynamic pacemakers, ideal pacing, moving refreshments, course selection, and weather control, and states that any one of these would independently suffice to make the attempt ineligible.[1]
findings.after_en: Rotating non-competing pacemakers and moving refreshments raised the assistance and feeding problems that made this specially organized attempt ineligible under ordinary record conditions. Ideal pacing, a suitable course and favourable weather are not each a violation merely because they help; the actual competition, course and assistance conditions matter.
findings.followup: Paragraph6 Each of these features departed... / 每一样都偏离 must become the overall arrangement did not meet ordinary record conditions; do not include favourable weather/course as inherently illegal. Paragraph7 people solely arranged to pace should not imply all hired pacemakers prohibited: lawful starters in same race can serve as pacemakers. Remove EN source lists/reporting frame and[1] only after direct prose correction.
findings.reason: Official regulations expressly allow identifiable pacemakers and official refreshments. Vienna was never ratifiable, but not every favourable condition independently constitutes a rule violation. No need to reconstruct every sanction route to correct this categorical error.

findings.before_zh: 这些泳姿在当时的规则下合法。
findings.after_zh: 这些成绩是在当时的规则下合法取得的。
findings.before_en: the performances were legal under the rules then in force
findings.after_en: NO-OP: English already uses performances, not swimming strokes.
findings.reason: The paragraph discusses approval of swimsuits and results, not whether the strokes themselves were legal.

findings.kind: source normative underdetermination versus absence of reasons / arbitrariness
findings.severity: required to preserve author's own competing-reasons argument
findings.location: EP12 section7 paragraphs5,7–8 and section8 paragraph10
findings.before_zh: 不是证据不够，证据非常充分，双方的论据都很完整。
findings.after_zh: 这不只是继续补证据就会自动消失的问题。材料还有缺口，但即使补得更多，仍需说明怎样权衡当时的合法性与长期可比性。
findings.before_en: It is not because evidence is lacking. The arguments on both sides are extensive.
findings.after_en: It is not a problem that more evidence alone would automatically dissolve. The record still has gaps; even a fuller account would require an explanation of how contemporaneous legality and long-term comparability should be weighed.

patches.before_zh: 这个裁定没有一个客观的依据
patches.after_zh: 这个裁定没有一个由现有证据唯一推出、排除所有其他方案的依据
patches.before_en: no objective standard uniquely compelled that decision
patches.after_en: NO-OP: English already preserves unique-compulsion distinction.

patches.before_zh: 所以它的裁定，不是一个有依据的裁定
patches.after_zh: 所以不能说它的裁定毫无依据；更准确地说，它的依据并没有唯一排除对面的方案
patches.before_en: The decision was therefore not uniquely grounded by an objective rule.
patches.after_en: NO-OP if retained in whole paragraph with its existing competing-ground explanation.

patches.before_zh: 选择是任意地选了一个。
patches.after_zh: 选择是在仍需说明与承担的取舍中采用了一个。
patches.before_en: choice selects a ground that could have been otherwise
patches.after_en: NO-OP: existing English does not call choice arbitrary.

patches.before_zh: 没有一个客观的原则告诉这个构该往哪边走。
patches.after_zh: 没有一个仅凭这些材料就能把其他合理方向全部排除的唯一原则。
patches.before_en: No objective principle told the construct which way to go.
patches.after_en: No single principle supplied by these materials excluded every other reasonable direction.

findings.reason: The essay itself gives substantive reasons on both sides and locates missing documents. No uniquely compelled option does not mean all evidence complete, no justification possible or choice arbitrary. Retain open reader judgment and both normative positions, not turn essay into author verdict. Related repeated no-answer/uniquely-correct phrasing is acceptable when it means this essay does not settle the choice.

findings.kind: source empirical impossibility presented inside opposing normative position
findings.severity: recommended qualification; English already substantially correct
findings.before_zh: 一条永远无法被穿着合规器械的后人接近的纪录
findings.after_zh: 假如某条纪录使使用合规器械的后来者长期处于难以接近的处境
findings.before_en: On this view, a mark that later athletes in compliant equipment could never approach would cease to be a monument worth aspiring to
findings.after_en: NO-OP: English explicitly makes this hypothetical on the annulment side, rather than asserting that every retained suit/shoe record is physiologically unreachable.
findings.reason: Keep strongest reclassification argument but don't certify permanent impossibility. The essay has provided no physiological ceiling proving legal successors can never approach records, and historical surpassing can occur. Source may express a normative hypothetical; make that grammatical. Do not insert an unverified current record count.

preserve_and_limits: EP11 main thesis is good: changing specifications can close a current progression without deleting valid historical marks. Preserve explicit non-annulment and no physical impossibility distinctions.
EP12 both institutions' retention/reclassification comparison and strongest competing principles are complete, useful and worth keeping. This review does not ask the author to pick a winner.
2020 forty-millimetre announcement is a historical event. Don't silently replace it with2026 shoe limits or imply its one-plate shorthand is a complete statement of every spike exception.

Author source's43 Rome world-record count, precise annual javelin leader list, complete suit-policy chronology, exact historical shoe-effect ranges and cycling UCI legal instruments were read but not all independently re-audited here. No full certification is claimed.

English editorial notes document deliberate source preservation. They are not suitable publication substitutes for resolving an acknowledged factual error; canonical import should strip notes/markers after correct direct prose is agreed.

Primary WA feature2022 was also inspected, but contains conflicting3cm andJune1984 details versus the committee account and official progression. Prefer the latter for4cm and20July; do not introduce a new false correction from a secondary institutional feature.
